title: How the band got the name Shawee
summary: The band's name came from a theme number the group made up, which Dr. Daniel mentioned in his newspaper column.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Did y'all call yourself the Shawees? Right. T'Paka Shawees.
Where did you get the name from?

Nope, I don't remember. Is that from the Mardi Gras Indians or something? No, no. This name, I think it came from one of the guys that played Nolan. His father used to go down around Old Sulfur hunting and fishing and whatnot. And this is kind of the language that people spoke down there. And this is about the closest thing we could, this is the only thing that we could remember, really. So we just took that name. And no, we didn't really take that name. No, we made up a little number and we played on the radio and we used that number as a theme song. What number was that? Shafaka Shawee, that was the name of the number. Really? And, and, uh, this is the name of the number that we made up and we gave it this name. And we played for Dr. Dale, we didn't have a name. And, uh, and Dr. Dale had a column in the newspaper, uh, every week in the Louisiana Weekly. And, all of a sudden we saw a write up in the paper about him, about us. And he said, he said here, those, um, Shafaka Shawee. So that's how the name started.
